TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ka tou wæ'i ka naunnamou ki pta ki pæ'i-habab-'an ni-sah-takkugh ta ti Maria Magda-lena, rou marimdim-appa, moukoua tou ravak: ka ni-kyt-ta-'n tyn ta vahttou ka 'eu-mi-'en-nato tou ravak.
S.TRANSL: The first day of the week cometh Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the sepulchre, and seeth the stone taken away from the sepulchre.
七日的第一日清早，天還黑的時候，抹大拉的馬利亞來到墳墓那裏，看見石頭從墳墓挪開了，

S.FORM: Annata ni-si-houm mou-koua ti Simon Petrus-an, ki Pah-tateutæu'-enappa ka sa'sat ka kavæangö-en ti Jesus, ka ni-kma neini-æn, Ara'n-nato ta Meirang, mæeumia tou ravak ka assi-mian kavan'an ni-makka-kounna ta neni tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then she runneth, and cometh to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and saith unto them, They have taken away the LORD out of the sepulchre, and we know not where they have laid him.
就跑來見西門‧彼得和耶穌所愛的那個門徒，對他們說：「有人把主從墳墓裏挪了去，我們不知道放在哪裏。」

S.FORM: Annata ni-tpæpænæh ta ti Petrus, ki Pahtatæutæu'-hanap-pa ka saäsat, ka ni-ierroua tou ra-vak.
S.TRANSL: Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the sepulchre.
彼得和那門徒就出來，往墳墓那裏去。

S.FORM: Râ darouha kanna ta ni-mahkaulla si-houm: râ Pahta-tæu'han-appa ka saäsat ta ni-si-houm si-ourou mæt'ægh ti Pe-trus-an, ka si-ouro'-en tyn mou-koua tou ravak.
S.TRANSL: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
兩個人同跑，那門徒比彼得跑得更快，先到了墳墓，

S.FORM: Irou ka mæ'æu-sousou, ni-kyt-t'an tyn ta atta-kou'-an ka æ̈-it, ra assi ni-mou-rbo' hynna.
S.TRANSL: And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in.
低頭往裏看，就見細麻布還放在那裏，只是沒有進去。

S.FORM: Ka ni-ierroua-appa ta ti Simon Petrus mæ-æ-ugh tyni-æn, ka ni-mou-rbou ta teni tou ravak, kmytta ki atta-kou'an ka ä-it.
S.TRANSL: Then cometh Simon Peter following him, and went into the sepulchre, and seeth the linen clothes lie,
西門‧彼得隨後也到了，進墳墓裏去，就看見細麻布還放在那裏，

S.FORM: Ka na ta t'oupou ki moul-la ka ni-atta-halap-pen tou voun-go tyn, assi ni-atta-sal-lan ki æ-it, râ ni-atta'-lbæh-enappa matta-'kkurik tou pani ki i-tou-kou'-an.
S.TRANSL: And the napkin, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself.
又看見耶穌的裹頭巾沒有和細麻布放在一處，是另在一處捲着。

S.FORM: Annata ni-mou-rbo-appa ta Pahtatæutæu-'han ka saäsat ka ni-si-ourou mou-koua tou r'avak, ka ni-k'yt-tan tyn, ka ni-tna'-'msing-appa.
S.TRANSL: Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the sepulchre, and he saw, and believed.
先到墳墓的那門徒也進去，看見就信了。（

S.FORM: Nda assi-appa-nein 'ou-mhg'an ta na Sa-Soulat, ka lyk-kough-eih tyn æhpit ki ni-kapa-tei-an.
S.TRANSL: For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead.
因為他們還不明白聖經的意思，就是耶穌必要從死裏復活。）

S.FORM: Anna-ta ni d'marang ta Pahtatæutæu-'han sa-lykkough mou-talagh.
S.TRANSL: Then the disciples went away again unto their own home.
於是兩個門徒回自己的住處去了。

S.FORM: Ka ni-myttouhkko ta ti Maria i-tou mala tou r'avak, ka tmangi-tangi. Irou ka tmangi-tangi ni-mæ'æu-sousou ta teni tou r'avak.
S.TRANSL: But Mary stood without at the sepulchre weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the sepulchre,
馬利亞卻站在墳墓外面哭。哭的時候，低頭往墳墓裏看，

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'yt-t-'an tyn ta ra-rouha ki Tama-Gnau tou [pa'mmi-'an ka] mapoulle, ka mier-roung ta saäsat tou voungö, sa'sat-appa tou rahpal, ki ni-atta-kou'-an ta vouel ti Jesus.
S.TRANSL: And seeth two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
就見兩個天使，穿着白衣，在安放耶穌身體的地方坐着，一個在頭，一個在腳。

S.FORM: Ka ni-k'ma ta neni tyni-æn, Ina, mang ka ta t'angit'angi-en-'nhou? Ni-k'ma neini-æn: Alei ka ni-ara ta Meirang-au, ka assi-mau 'ou-mhg'an ni-matta-kounna ta neni tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: And they say unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? She saith unto them, Because they have taken away my LORD, and I know not where they have laid him.
天使對她說：「婦人，你為甚麼哭？」她說：「因為有人把我主挪了去，我不知道放在哪裏。」

S.FORM: Irou ka mattæ'i-kaha ki atta, ni-rmyd-douk ta teni mæ-'æuvering, ka ni-k'yt-t-'an tyn ta ti Jesus ka myttouhko, râ assi tyn ou-mh'gan ka ti Jesus ta ti anna.
S.TRANSL: And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus.
說了這話，就轉過身來，看見耶穌站在那裏，卻不知道是耶穌。

S.FORM: Ni-kma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Ina, mang ta t'angit'angi-en-hou? timang ta ki'ym-men-hou? Tama-Si-rarahoul lava ni-koua tyn, ka ni-k'ma ta teni tyni-æn, Meirang, hei-rou ni-mara-kow tyni-æn pou-tauwagh, vann'-ei-koh ni-matta-kounna kow tyni-æn, ka ara-au-mau ta teni.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.
耶穌問她說：「婦人，為甚麼哭？你找誰呢？」馬利亞以為是看園的，就對他說：「先生，若是你把他移了去，請告訴我，你把他放在哪裏，我便去取他。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Maria. Irou ka mæ'æu-doum-ma ta teni ni-kma tyni-æn, Rab-bouni: ynna akoua-nnei ki sou, Tama-Mahtæutæuugh.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and saith unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master.
耶穌說：「馬利亞。」馬利亞就轉過來，用希伯來話對他說：「拉波尼！」（拉波尼就是夫子的意思。）

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Ynn'-ei-koh smoukkla, assi-appa mau ni-sa-bavau-en tou Ra-ram-'an-au: râ 'ou-koua-au ki tæ'i-appapara-au, vannavanna neini-æn, Sa-bavau-koh tou Ra-ram-'an-au tou Raram-'an-ap-pa moumi, tou Alid-au, tou Alid-appa-moumi.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God.
耶穌說：「不要摸我，因我還沒有升上去見我的父。你往我弟兄那裏去，告訴他們說，我要升上去見我的父，也是你們的父，見我的上帝，也是你們的上帝。」

S.FORM: Ka ni-mou-koua ta ti Ma-ria Mahdalena ma-hnau ki Pæh-tatæutæu-han, ka ni-k'yt-t'an tyn ta Meirang, ka ni-pa-sousou-en-appa tyn ta atta tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the LORD, and that he had spoken these things unto her.
抹大拉的馬利亞就去告訴門徒說：「我已經看見了主。」她又將主對她說的這話告訴他們。

S.FORM: Irou ka madoung-ato tou saäsat ki wæ'i kanna ka naunamou ki pta ki pa'i-habab'-an, rou ni-'illigh ta ngataf, tou ni-p-'æ-ä-kla-kla-'n ki Pahtatæutæu-han alei ki tahkout-'n-nein ki Joden, ni-ierroua ta ti Jesus myttouhko i-tou-toukkad, ka ni-k'ma neini-æn, Akou-reia ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and saith unto them, Peace be unto you.
那日（就是七日的第一日）晚上，門徒所在的地方，因怕猶太人，門都關了。耶穌來，站在當中，對他們說：「願你們平安！」

S.FORM: Irou ka mattæ'i-kaha ki at-ta ni-pa-k'yt-t-'an tyn neini-æn ta rima tyn ki kating-appa [tyn]. An-nata ni-marei ta Pahtatæutæu-han dou k'yt-t-'an nein ta Meirang.
S.TRANSL: And when he had so said, he shewed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the LORD.
說了這話，就把手和肋旁指給他們看。門徒看見主，就喜樂了。

S.FORM: : Annata ni-mattæ'i-la ta ti Jesus neini-æn, Akou-reia ymou-mi-æn: mama ki ni-padingi-en ki Rama jau-an, madingi-app-'oh ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father hath sent me, even so send I you.
耶穌又對他們說：「願你們平安！父怎樣差遣了我，我也照樣差遣你們。」

S.FORM: Irou ka ni-mattæ'i-kaha ki atta ni-mi-joep ta teni, k'ma neini-æn, 'Ara-au-to ta Joep-pan ka D'lligh Matiktik.
S.TRANSL: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and saith unto them, Receive ye the Holy Ghost:
說了這話，就向他們吹一口氣，說：「你們受聖靈！

S.FORM: Na mamang ka 'atta-ral-ei-moumi ta varau, 'atta-ral-eil-la-to k'anna neinï-an: na mamang-appa ka pa-i-kakoua-ei-moumi, pa-i-koua-eil-lato kanna neini-æn.
S.TRANSL: Whose soever sins ye remit, they are remitted unto them; and whose soever sins ye retain, they are retained.
你們赦免誰的罪，誰的罪就赦免了；你們留下誰的罪，誰的罪就留下了。」

S.FORM: Ka ti Thomas ka saät ki sat kyttiæn 'æb ki rouha, ka sihoua Didymus, assi i-tou-lam nei-ni-æn dou ierrou-'ato ta ti Jesus.
S.TRANSL: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
那十二個門徒中，有稱為低土馬的多馬；耶穌來的時候，他沒有和他們同在。

S.FORM: Annata ni-k'ma tyni-æn ta Pahtatæutæu-han ka rarouma, Ni-k'yt-ta ni-en ta Meirang, Râ ni-k'ma ta teni, Hei-rou assi-koh kmytta ki na loukka ki pahou tou rima tyn, rou assi-koh toummou ki kæ'æ-mous-au tou na loukka ki pahou, t'mmou-appa ki rima-au tou kating tyn, assi-koh tna-'msing-ah.
S.TRANSL: The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the LORD. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe.
那些門徒就對他說：「我們已經看見主了。」多馬卻說：「我非看見他手上的釘痕，用指頭探入那釘痕，又用手探入他的肋旁，我總不信。」

S.FORM: Ka si-æ̈'æugh ki kouh-yhpa ki wæ'i æ̈-i-a-rbou mi-la ta Pahtatæutæu-han, ka i-tou-lam neini-æn ta ti Thomas: ka ni-ier-roua ta ti Jesus rou ni-illif ta nga-taf, myttoukko i-tou toukkad, ka ni-k'ma, Akou-reia ymoumi-æn.
S.TRANSL: And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you.
過了八日，門徒又在屋裏，多馬也和他們同在，門都關了。耶穌來，站在當中說：「願你們平安！」

S.FORM: Si-æ̈'æugh ki anna ni-k'ma ti Thomas-an, Ad-dau-'to hia ki kæ'æmous-oho, k'yt-t-'ei ta rima-au, ka ad-dau-'to ta rima oho, t'ou ou-au tou kating-au, Ka ynnâ assi tna-'msing, râ tama-tna-'msing-appa.
S.TRANSL: Then saith he to Thomas, Reach hither thy finger, and behold my hands; and reach hither thy hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing.
就對多馬說：「伸過你的指頭來，摸我的手；伸出你的手來，探入我的肋旁。不要疑惑，總要信！」

S.FORM: Ka ni mattæ'i-v'lli ta ti Thomas k'ma tyni-æn, Meirang-au, Alid-dappa-mau.
S.TRANSL: And Thomas answered and said unto him, My LORD and my God.
多馬說：「我的主！我的上帝！」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Jesus tyni-æn, Alei ka ni-kmytta-kow jau-an Thomas, tna-'msing-ato kow: Tamatæ'i-riang ta assi ni-kmytta, ka tna-'msing-al-ato.
S.TRANSL: Jesus saith unto him, Thomas, because thou hast seen me, thou hast believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed.
耶穌對他說：「你因看見了我才信；那沒有看見就信的有福了。」

S.FORM: Madagh-appa ki na pou-kakidi ka pani ta ni pam't-ten ti Jesus tou æ-i-a-kou'-an ki Pahta-tæutæu-han tyn, ka assi ni-s'oulat-tin tou soulat katta.
S.TRANSL: And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book:
耶穌在門徒面前另外行了許多神蹟，沒有記在這書上。

S.FORM: Râ ni-s'oulat-tin ta ma-mang k'atta, alei ka tna-'msing-ah-kamou ka ti Jesus ta ti Christus, Alak ki Alid, ka rou tna-'msing-kamou ka akoume'-ah-ka-mou ki kæu'æ-han tou Nanang tyn.
S.TRANSL: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name.
但記這些事要叫你們信耶穌是基督，是上帝的兒子，並且叫你們信了他，就可以因他的名得生命。
